series: What if the countries were swapped?
title: What if Mbappé was Portuguese?
checked: Mbappé first called up March 2017; France won the 2018 World Cup and 2021 Nations League, lost the 2022 final (Wikipedia + 11v11 + CBS). 2026 World Cup: Mbappé Golden Boot with ten goals, France lost the semi to Spain (Wikipedia + Sortiraparis). Portugal won the Nations League 2019 and 2025 (UEFA + Wikipedia); France beat Portugal on penalties in the Euro 2024 quarter-final (Portugal Wikipedia; widely reported). Alternate world clearly imagined.

lines.text: What if Kylian Mbappé had been born in Portugal? Would he have more trophies, or fewer?
Real world first. Mbappé broke into the France team in twenty seventeen.
A year later, aged nineteen, he won the World Cup. France beat Croatia four-two.
Then the Nations League in twenty twenty-one.
And this summer, the Golden Boot again, with ten goals. But no trophy.
Now look at Portugal in exactly the same years.
Two Nations League titles. Same number of trophies as France.
But no World Cup. And at Euro twenty twenty-four, it was France who knocked Portugal out, on penalties.

scene.heading: EURO 2024
scene.body: Quarter-final: France 0, Portugal 0. France win 5-3 on penalties.

lines.text: So in this alternate world, Mbappé lines up next to Ronaldo.
On paper, it's two trophies either way. But he swaps a World Cup for a second Nations League.
Unless, in this imagined world, his goals carry Portugal much further in Russia and Qatar.
Better deal or worse deal? Tell me in the comments.
